rooms.name: Closet
rooms.lore: Four pots and a free bagseed. Every grow starts here.

rooms.name: Garage
rooms.lore: Eight pots, one cracked window. Costs 840 BUD: 2 x 420.

rooms.name: Garden Shed
rooms.lore: Out back, out of sight, twelve pots deep.

rooms.name: Basement
rooms.lore: Lights on 18/6 down here. Nobody upstairs asks.

rooms.name: Greenhouse
rooms.lore: Glass walls, real sun, twenty pots in flower.

rooms.name: High Voltage Warehouse
rooms.lore: Power-hungry and proud. Keep the meter spinning.

rooms.name: Vertical Farm
rooms.lore: Racks to the ceiling. Sea of Green: many small plants, fast flower.

rooms.name: Biodome I
rooms.lore: Forty-two pots under one dome. Croptober all year.

rooms.name: Biodome II
rooms.lore: Forty-two pots, Emerald Triangle scale, sealed under glass. The top grow.

strains.name: Bagseed
strains.lore: Seeds found in a bag of bought weed. Genetics unknown, cost zero.

strains.name: Ditch Weed
strains.lore: Feral cannabis. In 2006 NORML reported 98% of US-eradicated pot was ditchweed.

strains.name: Northern Lights Auto
strains.lore: An autoflower: ruderalis genes, it flowers by age, not light.

strains.name: Skunk #1
strains.lore: Afghani x Acapulco Gold x Colombian. The neighbors smell it first.

strains.name: Blue Dream
strains.lore: Blue, dreamy, and built for the long sesh.

strains.name: OG Kush
strains.lore: Topped a 2014 all-time list; nearly one in three new hybrids carried OG.

strains.name: White Widow
strains.lore: Reportedly Brazilian sativa x South Indian indica. First drop: day 1, 4:20 pm.

strains.name: Resin Stick
strains.lore: So much resin it glues your scissors shut.

strains.name: Gelato
strains.lore: Dessert-grade frost, iced in trichomes. Drops day 3 at 4:20 pm.

strains.name: Wedding Cake
strains.lore: Tiered, frosted, dense. Save a slice for the sesh.

strains.name: Sugar Kief
strains.lore: Candy-sweet and dusted in kief, the trichome powder.

strains.name: Afghani Mother
strains.lore: Only 200. Called a cornerstone of modern breeding. Clones come from mothers.

strains.name: Greenbox Genesis
strains.lore: Only 100. In Greenbox, the lost 1971 crop finally sprouts.

cosmetics.name: Garden Gnome
cosmetics.lore: Guards the grow. Has seen nothing. Says nothing.

cosmetics.name: Lava Lamp
cosmetics.lore: Slow blobs for a slow 4:20 afternoon.

cosmetics.name: Hemp for Victory Poster
cosmetics.lore: A 1942 USDA film urged US farmers to grow hemp for the war.

cosmetics.name: Golden Pot
cosmetics.lore: Only 500 cast. For the grower who has everything.

cosmetics.name: 4:20 Neon Clock
cosmetics.lore: A neon clock stuck at 4:20 pm. Only 100 lit.
